project_context: B2B Hotel Platform & RMS (ReveniQ, MyHotelBox) - 90+ panels
theme_strategy: Light mode for content areas (Dashboards, Tables, Forms) for high data legibility, and Dark mode for structural elements (Sidebar, Hero Cards) to create an 'Enterprise Command Center' feel.

headings.description: Used for all panel titles, KPI values, and hero sections. Geometric but humanistic, breaking away from standard 'AI-slop' generic fonts.

body.description: Used for tables, data grids, inputs, and standard text. Excellent for tabular figures, imparting a 'Swiss-engineered' professional feel.

primary.description: Sapphire Blue - A deep, trustworthy primary action color.

hero_card.description: Replaces generic flat gradients with a deep stone base overlaid with a subtle 10% primary tint for depth.

grids.dashboard_density: High Density Grid Strategy (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-6.
grids.kpi_cards: col-span-1, minimal padding (p-5), keeping numbers aligned to the left.
grids.data_tables: col-span-full or col-span-3, allowing horizontal expansion.
grids.spacing_scale: Strict use of Tailwind spacing. Internal card padding must be p-6 to avoid text collision.

layouts.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar (w-64). Dark theme (#0A0F1C) background with 1px right border.
layouts.header: Sticky top header, solid white background (bg-white) with a subtle bottom border (border-b border-slate-200) - NEVER transparent.
layouts.content_area: bg-[#F4F6F8]. Generous padding (p-6 md:p-8) to give data breathing room.
layouts.hero_card_pattern: Gradient dark stone card spanning the top row (col-span-full), rounded-lg, overlapping slightly with the content beneath to create z-axis depth.

border_radius.description: 8px (rounded-lg) for cards and buttons. Avoids the 'AI' overly pill-shaped or brutally sharp corners. Feels structurally sound.

shadows.description: Very soft, blue-tinted ambient shadows. Never use harsh black drop shadows.

components.buttons: Moderate border radius (rounded-md). Crisp hover states with background darkening and subtle transform (-translate-y-[1px]).
components.tables: Shadcn-based. Left-aligned text, right-aligned numbers. Header row has bg-slate-50 and border-b. Remove vertical borders for cleaner 'Stripe-like' look.
components.kpi_cards: Flat background (bg-white), 1px subtle border, soft shadow. Top-left oriented values for F-pattern scanning.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components. Inputs must have clear focus rings (ring-2 ring-blue-600/20 border-blue-600). Do not use generic native inputs.
components.dialogs: Solid white background, dark overlay (bg-slate-900/40 backdrop-blur-sm).

motion.micro_interactions: All interactive elements need hover states. Use transition-colors duration-200.
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for dashboard widgets (opacity-0 translate-y-2 -> opacity-100 translate-y-0) using CSS animations.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1). Dark hero cards must use text-white/90. Avoid pure white on light grey.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings on all inputs and buttons.

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react). Professional, consistent stroke weights.
media.image_usage: Images are used primarily in the public booking engine or login screens. Never use placeholders.

hotel_lobby_1.description: High-end luxury hotel lobby with a chandelier hanging from the ceiling

hotel_reception.description: Professional hotel reception desk with modern wooden furniture

hotel_room.description: Contemporary hotel room interior with pillows and cover on bed

instructions_to_main_agent: UPDATE index.css: Redefine the Shadcn root CSS variables based on the color and visual enhancers defined above (e.g., set --radius: 0.5rem, modify --primary to 226 71% 47% equivalent to #1D4ED8).
UPDATE tailwind.config.js: Add the font families 'Manrope' (for headings) and 'IBM Plex Sans' (for body) to the theme extension.
DO NOT rewrite the 90+ panels individually. Apply global styles that naturally inherit down to existing Shadcn and layout components.
ENSURE the dark sidebar is defined as a specific layout wrap class, e.g., 'bg-[#0A0F1C] text-slate-50', without altering the global light theme of the content area.
APPLY the hero card gradient globally to the designated hero component, using: bg-gradient-to-br from-stone-900 to-stone-800 with an absolute inset div of bg-blue-600/10.
REPLACE any 'Inter' or 'Roboto' imports in index.css or index.html with Manrope and IBM Plex Sans.
ADD data-testid attributes to core navigation items and main action buttons in the layout wrappers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Focus on high data legibility, structured alignment, and subtle interactions. Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic pure-black shadows, and uniform AI-slop styling. The application must look meticulously hand-crafted by an enterprise team. Use nested radii correctly (inner element radius < outer element radius). Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, but keep data tables flat and scannable. Never use transparent backgrounds on headers. Toast notifications must use Sonner.
